           BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

         IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                        )

         APPROVING ITS NEW EXTRA LARGE LOAD                         )
         TARIFF AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF                         )    CASE NO. PUD2026-000046
         SERVICE FOR EXTRA LARGE LOAD                               )
         CUSTOMERS AND A REGULATORY ASSET TO                        )
         RECOVER COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH                              )
         PORTFOLIO OPTIMIZATION SOFTWARE                            )


                                MOTION FOR PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE

               COMES NOW Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company (“OG&E” or the “Company”) and

        for its Motion for Procedural Schedule states as follows:

               1.      On June 17, 2026, OG&E filed its Application and Direct Testimony in this Case

        requesting that the Commission approve the Extra Large Power and Light Tariff, the Terms and

        Conditions of Service for Extra Large Load Customers, and a regulatory asset to track costs

        associated with the implementation of portfolio optimization software.

               2.      OG&E seeks an order from the Commission for a procedural schedule.

               3.      The Commission has jurisdiction to grant the relief requested herein by virtue of

        Okla. Const. art. IX, § 18, 17 O.S. § 151, et seq., and OAC 165:5.

               WHEREFORE, Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company requests the Commission issue an

        order setting a hearing date and issuing a procedural schedule for this matter.
